arguments.decision: Choose the first executable-decompilation tool path to attempt on this machine, with a complementary research path retained.

candidates.description: Build missing Ghidra macOS ARM native decompiler from installed source; read-only batch export of all saved functions with warnings/provenance.
Build experimental PS2Recomp and emit literal C++ from original ELF and existing function boundaries; separately measure instruction/runtime gaps.
Generate readable source solely from isolated disassembly with a generic language model.

arguments.evidence: Existing Ghidra12.1.3 saved FR2 project has3446 functions, r5900 processor extension works, release native decompiler missing on macOS ARM, clang/make available and bundled native source exists. PS2Recomp README says C++20 mostly tested MSVC, SSE4/AVX host support some vector paths, literal R5900/MMI/VU0 translation, partial/stubbed hardware. No FR2 runtime compatibility established.
arguments.priorities: User wants fully decompiled game; establish reproducible executable coverage before naming semantics, remain offline/static, avoid window/focus. Reuse verified local analysis.
requirements: Provides pseudocode tied to original function addresses.
Has plausible build path on macOS ARM without changing saved project.
Keeps missing coverage and warnings visible.
